definitions.no_cuda_activity: No recorded kernel, memcpy, or memset on this GPU inside a CPU NVTX stage envelope. RDMA DMA can be active in these intervals.
definitions.compute_kernel_union: Union of kernel intervals excluding NCCL/Ulysses synchronization and recognized layout kernels. This is not SM occupancy.
definitions.no_compute: Stage duration minus compute-kernel union; may contain communication, layout, copies, CPU work, launch gaps, and profiling overhead.
definitions.stage_boundaries: CPU NVTX ranges; asynchronous GPU work can cross these boundaries. Nested stages are not additive.
definitions.profile_timing: Diagnostic only; expanded graph nodes and device-wide metric sampling add overhead. Original benchmark median remains 5.417645 s.
